SRNE Shiner 60A MPPT Solar Charge Controller 12V/24V for Lithium Battery – Intelligent Power Management in Bangladesh

Overview

Empower your solar energy system with the advanced SRNE Shiner 60A MPPT Solar Charge Controller, specifically designed for optimal performance with 12V and 24V battery banks, including the increasingly popular Lithium (LiFePO4 and Li-ion) batteries. This high-efficiency Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) controller is engineered to maximize energy harvest from your solar panels, ensuring your batteries are charged quickly and safely, even under varying weather conditions. For anyone building or upgrading a solar setup in Bangladesh, whether for residential, commercial, or off-grid applications, the SRNE Shiner 60A offers unparalleled reliability and sophisticated battery management.

The SRNE Shiner 60A MPPT controller stands out in the Bangladesh market for its robust build, intelligent algorithms, and comprehensive protection features. It's an ideal choice for users seeking to get the most out of their solar investment, providing stable power delivery and extending battery lifespan. Discover why this 60A MPPT controller is becoming a go-to solution for efficient solar power management across Bangladesh.

Key Features

  • Advanced MPPT Technology: Boasts an impressive tracking efficiency of over 99.5%, ensuring maximum power extraction from your PV modules. This translates to more energy being converted into usable power for your home or business in Bangladesh.
  • Multi-Voltage System Compatibility: Automatically detects 12V or 24V battery systems, offering flexible integration into various solar setups.
  • Optimized for Lithium Batteries: Features dedicated charging algorithms for LiFePO4 and Li-ion batteries, ensuring their longevity and optimal performance. It also supports Sealed, Gel, and Flooded lead-acid batteries, providing versatile battery management.
  • High Conversion Efficiency: Achieves a peak conversion efficiency of up to 98%, minimizing energy loss during the charging process.
  • Comprehensive Electronic Protections: Equipped with multiple safeguards including overcharge, over-discharge, overload, short circuit, reverse polarity (PV and battery), and over-temperature protection, ensuring safe and reliable operation.
  • Intuitive LCD Display: A clear, backlit LCD screen provides real-time operational data, system status, and fault indications, making monitoring straightforward.
  • RS485 Communication Port: Allows for external display connectivity, PC monitoring, or mobile app integration (with optional accessories) for remote management and data logging, a crucial feature for advanced solar installations in Bangladesh.
  • Common Negative Grounding: Ensures compatibility and simplifies installation in many system configurations.
